sentences.text: 2. Heard Mr. S.R.S. Gill, learned counsel for the applicant and Mr. Deepak Bhardwaj, learned Brief Holder for the respondent no.1.

3. Mr. S.R.S. Gill, Advocate, has submitted that the Hon'ble Division Bench of this Court passed an order dated 17.09.2025 in which the Central Bureau of Investigation has been directed to take up investigation of all criminal cases concerned and, further, the concerned Investigating Officers and Station House Officers have been directed to handover the records and materials collected in all such cases to the Central Bureau of Investigation.

After the order of the Hon'ble Division Bench, if the trial court proceeds with the matter, the same will be a futile exercise, because after completion of the investigation, the Central Bureau of Investigation will again file final report.
4. Mr. Deepak Bhardwaj, Brief Holder, appearing for the State, has sought two weeks' time to inform the present status of the matter.
Till then, the further proceedings of Special Sessions Trial No. 9 of 2025 are stayed.

(Alok Kumar Verma, J.) 05.01.2026 Shiv/
